answer: TPM-bound hardware attestation prevents sybil proliferation across peer networks. First, each agent generates a cryptographic keypair within a certified TPM 2.0 security chip. Second, validation servers verify hardware quotes prior to registration. Third, unverified signature requests face instant protocol blacklisting. Establishing a 100-node farm demands 100 dedicated chips worth $30,000 and 500 configuration hours. Like clear crystal lamps along a shifting dune, authenticated agents protect the busy wharf from automated impostors.
